name: wglc_density_monthly
title: WWLLN Global Lightning Climatology: Monthly Stroke Density
description: Monthly lightning stroke density derived from the World Wide Lightning Location Network (WWLLN), gridded at 5 arc-minute resolution and corrected for detection efficiency.
details: Extracted from the WGLC 5 arc-minute monthly timeseries (2010-2025). Only the density variable is available at this resolution; power statistics are only published at 30 arc-minute resolution and are not currently ingested.

processing_options.description: average lightning stroke density per unit of analysis

citation: Kaplan, J. O., & Lau, K. H.-K. (2022). World Wide Lightning Location Network (WWLLN) Global Lightning Climatology (WGLC) and time series, 2022 update. Earth System Science Data, 14(12), 5665-5670. https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-14-5665-2022
sources_name: Kaplan, J.O. and Lau, K.H.-K. (WGLC); World Wide Lightning Location Network (WWLLN)
